description: Multi-Field Selector gives report users one compact place to filter across multiple related fields. Report authors can add fields in the required order without first creating a formal Power BI hierarchy. Use it for paths such as Region → Office → Team, Category → Product → Variant, or Year → Month → Week. Compatible values remain easy to find while users search, select individual values, or work with multiple branches and mixed hierarchy depths. Key benefits: • Replace several separate slicers with one coordinated selector. • Select across related fields and duplicate labels without losing their identity. • Choose single-selection or multiple-selection behaviour. • Search and sort each field independently. • Preserve selections in saved reports and bookmarks. • Work with external report filters and items with no data. • Configure fonts, colours, spacing, wrapping and field containers. • Use keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels and Power BI high-contrast themes. Multi-Field Selector is free, requires no separate account, and does not send report data or usage data to external services. Requirements: • Microsoft Power BI Desktop or Power BI Service. • At least one grouping field. • Relationships and filter direction configured appropriately in the Power BI semantic model. • Field order determines the hierarchy path shown by the visual.
